question: Based on pub_fin_data.sqlite (consolidated statements only), for H1 2024 vs H1 2025, which industry has the largest year-over-year decline in net profit margin?

deliverable_of_pipeline.note: single row: the industry whose consolidated net profit margin fell the most (in percentage points) from H1 2024 to H1 2025

data_understanding.grain: fact_income_statement is keyed by (company_id, period_date, period_type, report_type)

required_filters.report_type: 合并报表  (consolidated only; 母公司报表 has 0-revenue rows in 32 records -> would pollute margins)

data_understanding.coverage_check: Both H1-consolidated slices contain 172 companies and 39 industries -> balanced panel, no need for universe restriction. 2025-09-30 (Q3) only has 13 rows and is NOT used.
data_understanding.data_quality: net_profit and revenue are NOT NULL and revenue>0 for every consolidated row (zero-revenue rows occur only in 母公司报表), so net_profit/revenue is safe; currency is all CNY.

metric_definition.net_profit_margin: net_profit / revenue, expressed in percent (2 decimals) per the dataset's ratio rule
metric_definition.industry_aggregation: SUM(net_profit) / SUM(revenue) per industry-period (revenue-weighted; treats the industry as one entity). This is the documented primary aggregation for industry-level margin comparisons.
metric_definition.yoy_decline: delta_pp = margin_2025H1_pct - margin_2024H1_pct (negative = decline); select the industry with the minimum delta_pp (largest decline).

execution_steps.action: Aggregate consolidated H1 income statements by industry and period
execution_steps.sql: SELECT d.industry_name, f.period_date, SUM(f.net_profit) AS np, SUM(f.revenue) AS rev, SUM(f.net_profit)*100.0/SUM(f.revenue) AS margin_pct FROM fact_income_statement f JOIN dim_company d ON d.company_id=f.company_id WHERE f.report_type='合并报表' AND f.period_type='H1' AND f.period_date IN ('2024-06-30','2025-06-30') GROUP BY 1,2

execution_steps.action: Pivot to one row per industry with margin_2024, margin_2025, delta_pp = margin_2025 - margin_2024; sort ascending by delta_pp
Take the top row (most negative delta_pp) as the answer industry; write output.csv with header 'industry_name' and that single value

validation_checks: Both periods must return 39 industries and 172 distinct companies (balanced panel); if not, restrict to industries present in both periods.
Industry revenue sums > 0 in both periods for every industry (ensures no divide-by-zero).
Expected count of industries in the ranked table = 39.

Cross-check: overall (all-industry) consolidated margin must equal SUM(np)/SUM(rev) computed from the raw table for each period (should reproduce ~11.90% for 2024H1 and ~12.27% for 2025H1 from the profile's revenue/net_profit sums: 1,690,327,067,022.5/14,205,024,709,116.5 and 1,699,743,929,086.1/13,858,678,509,538.8).
Sign-direction check: max(delta_pp) should be a gainer (positive) so the ranking is not inverted.
sensitivity_and_caveats: Equal-weight (simple mean of company margins) vs revenue-weighted changes the winner because of single-company outliers (e.g. a software company whose margin went from -13.6% to -265.2%). Equal-weight ranking puts 软件和信息技术服务业 first (-49.4pp) and 房地产业 second (-33.7pp), while the weighted ranking puts 农副食品加工业 first (-6.7pp). The documented primary method (revenue-weighted, per dataset recommendations) must be used; note the alternative in any accompanying explanation.
13 of 39 industries contain only 1-2 companies, so their industry-level conclusions are weakly representative; the winning industry should be reported with its company count and revenue weight.
Do not use 2025-09-30 data and do not mix 母公司报表 into the margin computation.

feasibility_precheck.comment: Precheck only proves the method is executable and well-defined; downstream nodes should recompute independently and round to 2 decimals before writing output.csv.
